question: Which of the following was the first city planned by Mughal Empire?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fatehpur Sikri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fatehpur Sikri** was the **first planned city** of the Mughal Empire.
 
• It was founded by **Emperor Akbar** in the year 1571.
 
• Fatehpur Sikri served as the **capital of the Mughal Empire** from **1571 to 1585**.
 
• The city is known for its **architectural brilliance** and houses several important buildings, including the Buland Darwaza, Jama Masjid, and Panch Mahal.
 
• Fatehpur Sikri was abandoned in 1585 due to **water scarcity** and other logistical challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Mughal Empire was known for its **administrative efficiency** and **architectural innovations**.
 
• Akbar, one of the greatest Mughal emperors, was known for his policy of **religious tolerance** and efforts to create a **unified Indian empire**.
 
• Fatehpur Sikri is a** UNESCO World Heritage Site** and a popular tourist destination today.
 
• The city is a fine example of **Akbar's architectural vision** and his interest in blending different cultural influences.
